title: Early pregnancy counselling: what to tell her about lifestyle, substances and medicines, food, travel and nausea
root: Early pregnancy counselling: say what is safe, name the few real risks

drugs.name: Alcohol
drugs.moa: Zero is safest; low levels unlikely to harm.

drugs.name: Exercise
drugs.moa: Aerobic + strength, whatever her prior level.

drugs.name: Weight gain
drugs.moa: Lower BMI → gain more; discuss respectfully.

drugs.name: Likely safe
drugs.moa: Antihistamines, antiemetics, puffers, antidepressants, common antibiotics.

drugs.name: SSRIs
drugs.moa: No birth defects; slight ↑ postpartum hemorrhage.

groups.title: Food
groups.desc: Undercooked meat, not cats, is the toxo risk.

drugs.name: Very low risk
drugs.moa: Raw eggs, deli meat, soft cheese, sushi, most fish.

groups.title: Travel + nausea
groups.desc: NVP: from 4 wk, peaks 9 wk, gone by end of T1.

drugs.name: Travel
drugs.moa: Safest 18–23 wk; insurance rarely covers the baby.
